purpose: Map operator-facing README, AGENTS, robot-contract, attestation-manifest, and release-checklist claims to the retained evidence that proves, constrains, or blocks the wording.

claims.claim_text: README documents the committed number of tracked shell E2E scripts.
claims.source_of_truth_command: git ls-tree -r --name-only HEAD tests/e2e | awk '/\.sh$/ { count++ } END { print count + 0 }'
claims.freshness_rule: Release wording must use source.count_source=head and match the checked-in README marker value.

claims.claim_text: README points robot JSON/TOON envelope claims at the populated proofs/robot-contracts attestation slot.
claims.source_of_truth_command: git show HEAD:docs/attestations/manifest.json | jq -e '.slots[] | select(.category == "proofs/robot-contracts" and .path == "crates/frankenterm-core/tests/golden_robot_envelope/control_plane_golden_matrix.json")'
claims.freshness_rule: Manifest slot path must be non-null and the referenced golden matrix must exist.

claims.claim_text: AGENTS keeps high-scale resource-cockpit wording blocked while the retained target-class artifact is skipped_not_proven.
claims.freshness_rule: High-scale wording cannot graduate until status is no longer skipped_not_proven and the target-class summary is retained.

claims.claim_text: The attention-router contract is explicitly planned, not advertised as a live supported router.
claims.freshness_rule: Planned wording may cite static fixtures, but cannot be upgraded to supported until a future implementation bead publishes live router evidence.

claims.claim_text: The release attestation manifest has a populated doctrine/agents-md-counts slot.
claims.source_of_truth_command: git show HEAD:docs/attestations/manifest.json | jq -e '.slots[] | select(.category == "doctrine/agents-md-counts" and .path == "docs/attestations/doctrine/agents-md-counts.json")'
claims.freshness_rule: Manifest path must stay non-null and point at the checked-in head-sourced count snapshot.

claims.claim_text: The release checklist requires head-sourced README/AGENTS count stamping and snapshot regeneration.
claims.freshness_rule: Release checklist wording must mention --source=head and the checked-in snapshot path.

claims.claim_text: README holds back high-scale memory-envelope claims until a non-skipped target-class artifact exists.
claims.freshness_rule: High-scale wording remains blocked while the retained target-class artifact status is skipped_not_proven.
